scripts.install-desktop: mkdir -p ~/.local/share/applications ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/{48x48,128x128,256x256}/apps && cp mise.desktop ~/.local/share/applications/ && cp assets/icons/Mise-logo48.png ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/48x48/apps/mise.png && cp assets/icons/Mise-logo128.png ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/128x128/apps/mise.png && cp assets/icons/Mise-logo256.png ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/mise.png && update-desktop-database ~/.local/share/applications && gtk-update-icon-cache -f -t ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor
